data.transform:
$appConfig.mes.ospExternal
and
value.after.purcchaseOrderTypeId = "Outside Processor"
and
value.after.purchaseOrderStatusId in ["Pending Bill","Partially Received","Pending Billing/Partially Received"]
and
value.before.purchaseOrderStatusId != value.after.purchaseOrderStatusId

value.after.transferOrderTypeId = "Outside Processor"
and
value.after.transferOrderStatusId in ["Received"]
and
value.before.transferOrderStatusId != value.after.transferOrderStatusId

value.after.transferOrderTypeId = "Outside Processor"
and
$isNilOrEmpty(value.after.externalId)
and
value.after.transferOrderStatusId in ["Partially Fulfilled","Pending Receipt/Partially Fulfilled","Pending Receipt"]
and
value.before.transferOrderStatusId != value.after.transferOrderStatusId
